in_marathi.name: Soumitra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Subduer of Mental Pain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Soumitra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Soumitra is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Soumit', which means 'Subduer of Mental Pain'. This name is considered to be auspicious and is often given to boys in Hindu communities. The name signifies strength, wisdom, and intelligence.
